items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion - The Definitive Release
items.description: The ultimate upload of evangelion. Everything anime related to evangelion is here. This may be bold, but I think this is one of the best releases of this anime which is in one place. Each upload contains sub and dub (If possible) and I looked for the best possible releases for each.
